In tvm_tirx::ir::expr

tvm_tirx::ir::expr

Struct Expr 

Source 
pub struct Expr { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

The base of every expression: its source location loc and its type ty.

The type may be a MissingType while the expression is under construction. Each kind of expression is a subtype that adds its operands. PrimExpr and IntExpr are expressions checked to have a primitive or an integer type.

Implementations§

Source§

impl Expr

Source

pub fn new(loc: impl Into<Location>, ty: impl Into<Type>) -> Self

Lossless complete-field allocation.

Source§

impl Expr

Source

pub fn subscript( &self, indices: impl IntoIterator<Item = Subscript>, loc: impl Into<Location>, ) -> Result<Any>

Return self[indices], as the subscript rule of its type realizes it: a TupleGetItem of a tuple, a TensorLoad or TensorRegion of a tensor (ir.SubscriptExprRealize).

§Errors

Returns a TypeError if the type of the expression has no subscript rule, or the error the rule raises.

impl ObjectRefAnyCompatible for Expr

Source§

fn extra_check(obj: &Self::ContainerType) -> bool

Whether obj, an instance of ContainerType, is a value of Self. Every strict and converting cast checks it, after the object type.
Source§

fn convert_fallback(value: AnyView<'_>) -> Option<Self>

Convert a value that is not a Self object, such as an integer that stands for a constant; None rejects it. Only converting casts (TryFrom<Any>, typed function arguments) call it; downcast_ref, downcast and match_any! never do.
Source§

fn custom_type_str() -> String

The type name in conversion errors and type schemas; by default the object’s type key. See AnyCompatible::type_str.
Source§

fn custom_mismatch_type_info(value: AnyView<'_>) -> String

The name of the mismatched value in conversion errors; by default its runtime type key. See AnyCompatible::get_mismatch_type_info.
Source§

Whether two references point to the same object.

where B: ObjectRefCore,

Take self as B, a subtype or a container such as Array<i64> whose elements are checked too, when its object is one, without copying it. On a mismatch the reference is returned unchanged. Read more
